decision: Adopt removal of the second explicit-variation replay. All public output digests and warnings match across 8160 samples; every round improves 8/128/512 synthetic-extra-setting cases. Ordinary 0/1 cases have small and sometimes reversed round differences, so no common-case speedup claim.

reproduction.source: Archive engine_revision into before/after below a task-specific mktemp -d -p "$HOME/tmp" directory. Keep identical Cargo.lock. Replace dev/bench/examples/style_metric_instances.rs with probe_source in both archives; apply production_patch only in after. Compare production source trees and ensure only shape/instance.rs differs.
reproduction.build: TMPDIR="$HOME/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo build --offline --locked --release -p shodo-bench --example style_metric_instances --target-dir <version-specific-target>; use an independent target directory for each version and verify different binary SHA-256 fingerprints.
reproduction.run: For each round 0..3, form jobs in extra-setting order [0,1,8,128,512] and version order [before,after]. Shuffle each round with one continuous Python random.Random(20261010). Each job runs SHODO_EXTRA_VARIATIONS=<count> taskset -c 2 <version-binary> time. Each process emits 51 samples after 3 warmups for each of 4 fixtures. Compare output equality for every matching extra-setting/fixture before considering elapsed values.
reproduction.cleanup: Record source, patch, binary and raw-data fingerprints, per-round timing summaries, output digests and verification results; remove only this task-specific directory after recording.

limitations: Extra settings are synthetic distinct unknown tags, retained in public variations. This is a stress test of author-setting replay, not a claim about realistic font axis counts.
64 short spans with distinct font sizes amplify instance preparation; no claim about overall application or long-text performance.
Small ordinary 0/1-setting differences do not establish a robust common-case improvement.
Benchmark fixtures emit no warnings. Existing semantic tests separately cover adjusted-size saturation, unavailable metrics and warning suppression.
Only the redundant explicit-setting replay was removed; preliminary coordinates for size-adjust, automatic opsz, clamping and coordinate generation remain unchanged.
